paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: 95% CL exclusion from Fermi-LAT observations of GW170817 (purple shaded region, Fig. 4 = figures/limits.pdf in the e-print). Curve recovered exactly from the vector PDF: the solid thick purple stroke is a 13-vertex polyline; axes calibrated from major tick marks (x: 0.01-1000 MeV, y: 1e-12 to 1e-7 GeV^-1, both log). The limit is a closed island-shaped contour, so points trace the boundary (upper branch from where it exits the plot top at m_a~0.034 MeV/g=1e-7 GeV^-1, down to the tip at m_a~108 MeV, g~7e-12 GeV^-1, then back along the lower branch), not monotonic in mass. Lower branch clipped at the plot's left edge (m_a~0.008 MeV); in the source path it continues off-plot to lower masses. Not a dark-matter search, so no rho_DM rescaling. Projections in the same figure (stacked, x10 closer, future) were excluded.
